Looking to buy a Louis Vuitton bag as an investment? Authentic Louis Vuitton bags in general tend to hold their value. Style, material and condition, however, all impact value retention.


Typically, classic LV canvas styles retain 80 to 100 percent of their retail value on resale. Some models, like the Neverfull and OnTheGo, trade above their original price.


Vuitton’s portfolio is built on a fundamental material split between treated canvas and genuine leather. Here are some of the most sought-after iconic silhouettes.


---


## **The Most Iconic Louis Vuitton Bags**


[Louis Vuitton Bitume Metallise Vernis Epi Monogram Alma BB, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/louis-vuitton-bitume-metallise-vernis-epi-monogram-alma-bb/id-v_30882592/)


### **Alma**


Released in the 1930s, the Alma is distinguished by its structured dome silhouette, revealing its Art Deco roots. Instantly recognizable by its sturdy double handles, signature base studs and meticulous five-stitch handle-tab detailing, it is highly sought after by collectors and fashion enthusiasts. Browse[Alma listings](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/louis-vuitton-alma/) .


[Louis Vuitton Damier Azur Keepall 50 Duffle, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/luggage-travel-bags/louis-vuitton-damier-azur-keepall-50-duffle/id-v_30278742/)


### **Keepall**


The Keepall is considered the grandfather of modern travel luggage. It was released in 1930 as a flexible companion piece to Louis Vuitton’s hard-sided trunks. Engineered to be completely packable, water-resistant and extraordinarily durable, the Keepall embodies the brand’s coated-canvas heritage. Browse[Keepall listings](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/keepall-louis-vuitton-bags/) .


[Louis Vuitton Speedy 25 Bandouliere Fornasetti Louvre Stamps, 2010-](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/shoulder-bags/louis-vuitton-speedy-25-bandouliere-fornasetti-louvre-stamps/id-v_26053762/)


### **Speedy**


The Speedy, introduced in 1932 as the Express, emerged from the era’s rapid-transit boom. Inspired by the Keepall, it was a practical, everyday town bag. Its duffel-like shape became a permanent pop-culture symbol in 1965, when Audrey Hepburn requested a smaller custom version. Browse[Speedy listings](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/louis-vuitton-speedy/) .


[Louis Vuitton Neverfull GM Graffiti Stephen Sprouse LE, 2019](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/borsa-mano-louis-vuitton-neverfull-gm-graffiti-stephen-sprouse-le-2019/id-v_20655712/)


### **Neverfull**


The Neverfull, launched in 2007, is the brand’s workhorse tote. It holds a lot of weight without sacrificing its structural integrity. Eternally in demand and appearing in endless iterations, it is a top resale performer. Browse[Neverfull listings](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/louis-vuitton-neverfull-bag/) .


[Louis Vuitton Black & Arizona Taurillon Capucines PM Bag M59466, 2010-](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/louis-vuitton-black-arizona-taurillon-capucines-pm-bag-m59466/id-v_29544582/)


### **Capucines**


Named for the Parisian street where the house opened its first store, in 1854, the Capucine swaps the brand’s classic coated canvas for premium full-grain leathers.


[Louis Vuitton Metallic Gold Python Twist PM, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/shoulder-bags/louis-vuitton-metallic-gold-python-twist-pm/id-v_25331312/)


### **Twist**


First featured on a runway in 2014, the Twist is a modern, chic, day-to-evening bag defined by its leather construction and hardware-forward locking system.

## **Which Louis Vuitton Bags Hold Their Value Best**


[Louis Vuitton Monogram Reporter PM Crossbody Bag s29lv25, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/crossbody-bags-messenger-bags/louis-vuitton-discontinued-monogram-reporter-pm-crossbody-bag-s29lv25/id-v_14812982/)


Certain Louis Vuitton bags, including[1stDibs’ Louis Vuitton tote bags](https://www.1stdibs.com/creators/louis-vuitton/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/tote-bags/) , hold their value better than others.


- Top performers include Neverfull, OnTheGo and Pochette Métis


- Mid-performers include Speedy and Alma


- Lesser performers include Capucines, whose resale values have softened because of market saturation


Limited editions and collaborations with artists like Stephen Sprouse, Takashi Murakami and Virgil Abloh are the categories most likely to appreciate in value, since they’re discontinued so supply is finite.

## What Drives Resale Value


[Louis Vuitton Monogram Crossbody Bag, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/crossbody-bags-messenger-bags/louis-vuitton-monogram-canvas-vachetta-leather-chantilly-crossbody-bag/id-v_29760252/)


A Louis Vuitton bag’s resale value depends on the following factors:


- The material (coated canvas vs. leather vs. exotic)
- Rarity/discontinued status
- Condition
- Completeness (dust bag, lock and key, box)
- Documented provenance


A common misconception is that all Louis Vuitton bags are made entirely of leather. The iconic monogram and Damier (checkerboard) graphics, however, are printed on coated cotton canvas, not leather. This canvas is highly durable, water-resistant and sealed with a textured PVC resin layer.


The trim and handles on these classic bags are made from untreated Vachetta leather. Environmental exposure and everyday wear can cause it to darken over time, changing from a pale, creamy beige to a rich, warm honey color. Look for an even patina. This is a sign of authenticity and character, not a flaw.


You can see how patination intensifies a bag’s beauty by browsing[1stDibs’ Vachetta leather Louis Vuitton pieces](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/vachetta-leather-louis-vuitton/) . If you want to invest in a completely leather Louis Vuitton bag, look at collections like Capucines and Twist.

## **How to Check Authenticity Before You Buy**


[Louis Vuitton Monogram Canvas Montaigne GM Tote, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/tote-bags/louis-vuitton-monogram-canvas-montaigne-gm-tote/id-v_30607672/)


Refer to this checklist before buying your first (or next) Louis Vuitton bag.


- Logo alignment: On genuine bags, the main LV monogram is continuous, not abruptly cut off at the bottom or sides. The monogram or Damier pattern should line up evenly across the seams, folds and pockets.


- Five-stitch handle-tab detail on Alma/Speedy/Neverfull: Authentic pieces typically feature a consistent stitch count (five distinct stitches across the top of the chape, with the number varying slightly by period of manufacture).


- Stamp font details: The heat-stamped “Louis Vuitton Paris” should be in a clean, thin font.


- Hardware engraving sharpness: Metal pieces (zipper pulls, D-rings, locksets) should be made of solid brass, with a heavy feel and crisp, clean “Louis Vuitton” lettering.


It’s worth noting that date codes are production stamps, not serial codes. They tell you where and when a bag was made. So thousands of bags manufactured in the same factory during the same week will share the same date code.


The date codes are included in bags made from the 1980s to 2021. After that, Louis Vuitton switched to embedded NFC microchips, so a missing date code on a newer bag is normal, not a red flag.


When seeking an authentic bag, it’s best to buy from vetted marketplaces and sellers. You can learn more in this guide:[How to Spot a Fake Louis Vuitton](https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/fake-louis-vuitton/) .

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Do Louis Vuitton bags hold their value?**


Yes, generally. Classic canvas styles like the Neverfull and Speedy often retain 80 to 100 percent of their retail value. The market for structured-leather styles like Capucines has softened recently because of saturation.


### **Which Louis Vuitton bag has the best resale value?**


Neverfull and OnTheGo are consistent top performers. But the Pochette Métis and classic Speedy also command strong demand.


### **Is Louis Vuitton a better investment than Chanel or Hermès?**


Louis Vuitton offers more accessible pricing and greater resale liquidity, but the very top[Chanel](https://www.1stdibs.com/creators/chanel/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/) and[Hermès](https://www.1stdibs.com/creators/hermes/) pieces can appreciate faster. Buying Louis Vuitton is often the more dependable, lower-volatility choice.


### **How can you tell if a Louis Vuitton bag is authentic?**


Check that the monogram or Damier pattern lines up across seams; the handle-tab stitching is even and consistent; the heat stamp uses a clean, thin font; and the hardware feels heavy with crisp engraving. No single detail proves authenticity on its own, so buying from a vetted seller is the safest route.


### **Is buying a vintage or preowned Louis Vuitton bag worth the expense?**


Yes, particularly for canvas classics. Buying vintage or preowned is the main way to access these bags below full retail price.


---


## **Find a Louis Vuitton Bag Worth Buying**


Is a Louis Vuitton worth the expense?


Classic canvas styles in good condition from a vetted seller are definitely worth the money. So are higher-priced leather pieces like Capucines, if the style and price are right.
